prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1305; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting pain and reduced motion in the right shoulder. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported force and direction of the crash, and the clinical picture fits an acute soft-tissue and rotator cuff strain. Over eight visits, care included physical examination, range-of-motion testing, targeted therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Several examination findings, including limited abduction and tenderness over the supraspinatus, support the reported injury, while neurological screening and strength testing within the normal limits were unremarkable. The patient's history includes treatment to the same shoulder region within the past two years, and that prior condition is likely contributing to some of the current symptoms. Treatment followed a typical course, with visit frequency decreasing as the patient improved and symptoms became more manageable. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. Ongoing home exercise and follow-up as needed are recommended.
